tasks: In src/pricing.ts rename quote's returned amount property to net and add currency (default CNY). Keep quote's signature. Coordinate compatibility with existing callers; preserve existing tests.

In src/cart.ts add exported invoiceLabel(price, currency) using pricing.quote(price, 0.1, currency). Format its price as currency followed by a space and two decimal places. Update invoiceNet to consume quote's current price property. Preserve existing tests.
In src/intervals.ts rename capacity's returned occupied property to used. Preserve existing callers through a compatible interface when collaborators need it. Keep available unchanged.

In src/availability.ts add exported roomSummary(minutes) using intervals.capacity(minutes, 0.1, 'room'). Return the occupied minutes followed by '/' and available minutes. Update roomPressure to use the current capacity interface. Preserve existing tests.

In src/weights.ts add weightDetails(bytes, overhead, category), returning {bytes: entryWeight(bytes, overhead, category)}. Refactor entryWeight's internal calculation into weightDetails so the new result object is the implementation source. Preserve the public numeric entryWeight API.

In src/lru.ts add exported admittedLabel(bytes) using the weight calculation from weights.ts for image entries at overhead 0.1. Return the allocated byte count followed by ' bytes'. Refactor admittedBytes to share the chosen calculation. Preserve existing tests.
In src/width.ts extend lineMetrics to include total: columns. Preserve padding and usable.
In src/layout.ts add exported layoutSummary(columns) using width.lineMetrics(columns, 0.1, 'letter'), returning usable + '/' + total. Preserve existing exports and tests.
In src/retry.ts extend retryBudget to include exhausted: remaining === 0. Preserve wait and remaining.
In src/delivery.ts add exported retrySummary(attempt) using retry.retryBudget(attempt, 2, 'standard'). Return 'stop' when exhausted, otherwise String(wait). Preserve tests.
In src/tariffs.ts extend chargeBreakdown with total: amount / creditUnit + tax. Preserve existing behavior and fields.
In src/invoices.ts add exported chargeLabel(units) using tariffs.chargeBreakdown(units, 0.1, 'ordinary').total, formatted to two decimal places. Preserve tests.
In src/pricing.ts extend quote with gross: amount / minorUnit + tax. Preserve the existing fields and signatures.
In src/cart.ts add exported grossEstimate(price) using pricing.quote(price, 0.1, 'CNY').gross. Preserve existing tests.
In src/intervals.ts extend capacity with full: available === 0. Preserve existing fields.
In src/availability.ts add exported roomFull(minutes) using intervals.capacity(minutes, 0.1, 'room').full. Preserve tests.
In src/weights.ts extend memoryBudget with overBudget: allocated / byteUnit > 1048576. Preserve its existing fields.
In src/lru.ts add exported fitsBudget(bytes) using weights.memoryBudget(bytes, 0.1, 'image').overBudget, returning true when within budget. Preserve tests.

In src/retry.ts add retryWindow(attempt) returning { delay: retryDelay(attempt, 2, 'standard'), attemptsLeft: Math.max(0, 6 - Math.floor(attempt)) }. Refactor retryBudget to call this helper while preserving its existing returned fields.
In src/delivery.ts add exported retryWindowLabel(attempt) using retry.retryWindow(attempt). Return delay + ':' + attemptsLeft. Preserve tests.
Extend quote in src/pricing.ts with currency defaulting to CNY. Preserve amount and tax.

Add exported currencyLabel(price, currency) in src/cart.ts using pricing.quote(price, 0.1, currency).currency and the quoted amount; format as 'USD 90.00' for price 100 and currency USD. Preserve tests.
Extend capacity in src/intervals.ts with utilization: occupied / minuteUnit / 480. Preserve occupied and available.
Add exported roomUtilization(minutes) in src/availability.ts using intervals.capacity(minutes, 0.1, 'room').utilization. Preserve tests.
Extend memoryBudget in src/weights.ts with fraction: allocated / byteUnit / 1048576. Preserve existing fields.
Add exported budgetFraction(bytes) in src/lru.ts using weights.memoryBudget(bytes, 0.1, 'image').fraction. Preserve tests.
